about: What the MCP client says when a remote server refuses it (2026-09-29, the skills and MCP e2e). The Python client wrapped an HTTP 401 in an anyio task group and `doctor` printed `unhandled errors in a TaskGroup (1 sub-exception)`; the TypeScript client printed the transport's own line (`Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: {..."Unauthorized"...}`); neither said that a credential was needed, and both fix lines said to fix the server's entry. Both skills now unwrap an exception group to its root cause, and when the cause is HTTP 401 or 403 (`credential_statuses`) the server's report row carries `needs_credential` (the sentence, `{status}` and `{name}` filled) with its `needs_credential` flag set, and `doctor`'s fix line is `cli/secrets.json` `doctor.words.fixCredential`, never `fixEntry`. `{name}` is the secret name suggested for the server: `suggested_secret_name(server, "token")`, `<SERVER>_TOKEN`. Neither SDK signs in to an MCP server with OAuth. Python: webagents/agents/skills/local/mcp/connect_errors.py, tests/agents/skills/test_mcp_connect_errors_sdk5.py; TypeScript: src/skills/mcp/connect-errors.ts, tests/unit/skills/mcp-connect-errors-sdk5.test.ts.
needs_credential: needs a credential (HTTP {status}): put a bearer token in the entry's headers as Authorization: Bearer ${secret:{name}}; OAuth sign-in to MCP servers is not supported yet

server_stopped.about: A stdio server that stops before the MCP handshake (2026-09-29, the owner's yoyo agent: `uvx mcp-server-sqlite` got the server's last release with `mcp` 2.2.0 and died at start, and both chats said only `Connection closed`). When the connection closes before the handshake, the row says `sentence` with the last error line the server wrote to its stderr log during this attempt and the log's path (home written `~`); `silent` when it wrote nothing; `unlogged` when its stderr could not be kept. The error line: blank lines, stack frames (`    at ...`), Node's `Node.js vN` footer, caret or tilde markers and lone braces are skipped, the last unindented line is preferred (else the last line), leading decoration (uv's `×`, `╰─▶`) is dropped, and a line longer than `line_max` ends in `…`. Python: connect_errors.py `last_error_line`, `server_stopped_sentence`, skill.py `_open_server`; TypeScript: connect-errors.ts `lastErrorLine`, `serverStoppedSentence`, skill.ts `_openServer`. Tests: tests/agents/skills/test_mcp_server_stopped.py, tests/unit/skills/mcp-server-stopped.test.ts.
server_stopped.sentence: the server stopped before it answered: {line} (its output: {log})
server_stopped.silent: the server stopped before it answered and wrote nothing to its error output
server_stopped.unlogged: the server stopped before it answered

command_missing.about: A stdio server whose command is not there (2026-09-29): Python said `[Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'uvx'` and TypeScript `spawn uvx ENOENT`, with nothing about what to install. Before a stdio server starts, its command is looked for on the PATH it gets (a bare name) or as a file (one written with a separator); when it is not there the row says `sentence` with the command as written and its hint (`hints`, by base name, `.exe`/`.cmd`/`.bat` dropped, `default` for any other), carries `needs_command`, and `doctor`'s fix line is `cli/secrets.json` `doctor.words.fixCommand`. Python also looks for a missing `uvx` beside its own interpreter and in the `uv` package (`pip install 'webagents[uv]'`) first. Python: connect_errors.py `command_missing_sentence`, skill.py `_command_found`, `_uv_fallback`; TypeScript: connect-errors.ts `commandMissingSentence`, skill.ts `commandFound`.
command_missing.sentence: {command} is not installed or not on PATH: {hint}

hints.uvx: it comes with uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/, or `pip install uv`)
hints.python: install Python 3, or name the interpreter's full path
hints.python3: install Python 3, or name the interpreter's full path
hints.default: install it, or give its full path as the entry's command
